# Implementation: Add ACK-Managed Logs S3 Bucket + IRSA Role + Flux Kustomization

## Directory Structure

```
infra/
├── s3/
│   ├── logs/
│   │   ├── kustomization.yaml (base)
│   │   ├── bucket.yaml
│   │   ├── public-access-block.yaml
│   │   └── overlays/
│   │       ├── dev/
│   │       │   └── kustomization.yaml
│   │       └── prod/
│   │           └── kustomization.yaml
│   └── kustomization.yaml (update to include logs)
├── iam/
│   ├── logs-irsa/
│   │   ├── kustomization.yaml (base)
│   │   ├── service-account.yaml
│   │   ├── role.yaml
│   │   ├── role-policy-attachment.yaml
│   │   └── overlays/
│   │       ├── dev/
│   │       │   └── kustomization.yaml
│   │       └── prod/
│   │           └── kustomization.yaml
│   └── kustomization.yaml (update to include logs-irsa)
flux/
├── kustomizations.yaml (update with logs sources)
└── sources/
    └── knr-ops-logs.yaml (optional: separate source or reuse existing)
```

---

## Files to Create

### 1. ACK S3 Bucket Resources

**`infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml`** (base)
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

namespace: kube-system

resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml

commonLabels:
  app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp-logs
  app.kubernetes.io/component: s3
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: ACK
```

**`infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml`** (base – template)
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  # Versioning
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: "Enabled"
  
  # Server-side encryption with AES256
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    - ruleSet:
        - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
            sseAlgorithm: "AES256"
  
  tags:
    - key: Environment
      value: dev  # Will be patched per overlay
    - key: ManagedBy
      value: ACK
```

**`infra/s3/logs/public-access-block.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: PublicAccessBlockConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-pab
spec:
  bucketRef:
    name: myapp-logs
  blockPublicAcls: true
  blockPublicPolicy: true
  ignorePublicAcls: true
  restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

**`infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

bases:
  - ../../

patchesJson6902:
  - target:
      group: s3.services.k8s.aws
      version: v1alpha1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/tags/0/value
        value: dev
  
  - target:
      group: s3.services.k8s.aws
      version: v1alpha1
      kind: PublicAccessBlockConfiguration
      name: myapp-logs-pab
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/bucketRef/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
```

**`infra/s3/logs/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

bases:
  - ../../

patchesJson6902:
  - target:
      group: s3.services.k8s.aws
      version: v1alpha1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: myapp-logs-prod
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/tags/0/value
        value: prod
  
  - target:
      group: s3.services.k8s.aws
      version: v1alpha1
      kind: PublicAccessBlockConfiguration
      name: myapp-logs-pab
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/bucketRef/name
        value: myapp-logs-prod
```

---

### 2. IRSA Role + Policy

**`infra/iam/logs-irsa/kustomization.yaml`** (base)
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

namespace: kube-system

resources:
  - service-account.yaml
  - role.yaml
  - role-policy-attachment.yaml

commonLabels:
  app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp-logs
  app.kubernetes.io/component: irsa
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: ACK
```

**`infra/iam/logs-irsa/service-account.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/myapp-logs-irsa-dev
    # Will be patched per environment
```

**`infra/iam/logs-irsa/role.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  # AssumeRolePolicyDocument with OIDC trust relationship
  # Requires cluster OIDC endpoint: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {
            "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E"
          },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E:sub": "system:serviceaccount:kube-system:myapp-logs"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  tags:
    - key: ManagedBy
      value: ACK
```

**`infra/iam/logs-irsa/role-policy-attachment.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy
spec:
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject",
            "s3:DeleteObject",
            "s3:GetObjectVersion"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-*/*"
        },
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:ListBucket",
            "s3:ListBucketVersions"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-*"
        }
      ]
    }
  tags:
    - key: ManagedBy
      value: ACK
---
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy-attachment
spec:
  roleName: myapp-logs-irsa
  policyRef:
    name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy
```

**`infra/iam/logs-irsa/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

bases:
  - ../../

patchesJson6902:
  - target:
      kind: ServiceAccount
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/annotations/eks.amazonaws.com~1role-arn
        value: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/myapp-logs-irsa-dev
  
  - target:
      group: iam.services.k8s.aws
      version: v1alpha1
      kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/assumeRolePolicyDocument
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {
                  "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E"
                },
                "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                "Condition": {
                  "StringEquals": {
                    "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E:sub": "system:serviceaccount:kube-system:myapp-logs",
                    "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                  }
                }
              }
            ]
          }
```

**`infra/iam/logs-irsa/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`** (similar, with prod account/role name)

### 3. Flux Kustomization

**`flux/kustomizations.yaml`** (add the following; merge with existing)
```yaml
---
# Logs S3 Bucket – Dev
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-s3-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops  # Adjust to your source name
    namespace: flux-system
  path: ./infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  wait: true
  validation: client
  dependsOn:
    - name: logs-irsa-dev  # Ensure IAM is ready first
---
# Logs S3 Bucket – Prod
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-s3-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
    namespace: flux-system
  path: ./infra/s3/logs/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  wait: true
  validation: client
  dependsOn:
    - name: logs-irsa-prod
---
# Logs IRSA (Role + SA) – Dev

kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
    namespace: flux-system
  path: ./infra/iam/logs-irsa/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  wait: true
  validation: client
---
# Logs IRSA (Role + SA) – Prod
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
    namespace: flux-system
  path: ./infra/iam/logs-irsa/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  wait: true

```

---

## Configuration Notes & Next Steps

### Before Deployment

1. **Replace placeholders** in IAM role OIDC trust policy:
   - `ACCOUNT_ID`: AWS account ID
   - `REGION`: AWS region (e.g., `us-east-1`)
   - `EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E`: Your cluster's OIDC provider ID (get via `aws eks describe-cluster --name <cluster> --query 'cluster.identity.oidc.issuer'`)

2. **ACK Controllers**: Ensure AWS Controllers for Kubernetes are installed for S3 and IAM APIs:
   ```bash
   helm repo add aws-controllers-k8s https://aws-controllers-k8s.github.io/community
   helm install ack-s3-controller aws-controllers-k8s/s3 -n ack-system --create-namespace
   helm install ack-iam-controller aws-controllers-k8s/iam -n ack-system --create-namespace
   ```

3. **Update parent Kustomizations** (if using):
   - Add `infra/s3/logs` and `infra/iam/logs-irsa` references to parent `infra/s3/kustomization.yaml` and `infra/iam/kustomization.yaml` if they aggregate overlays.

4. **Commit & Push**: Add all files to Git and push to trigger Flux reconciliation.

### Verification

```bash
# Check Flux Kustomizations
kubectl get kustomization -n flux-system | grep logs

# Check ACK resources
kubectl get bucket -n kube-system
kubectl get publicaccessblockconfigurations -n kube-system
kubectl get role,policy,rolepolicyattachment -n kube-system -l app.kubernetes.io/name=myapp-logs

# Check ServiceAccount annotation
kubectl get sa myapp-logs -n kube-system -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations}'
```

### Optional: SOPS Encryption

If storing OIDC endpoints or sensitive config in secrets:
```bash
sops -e --aws-profile <profile> -i infra/iam/logs-irsa/overlays/dev/secrets.yaml
```
Reference in kustomization.yaml:
```yaml
secretGenerator:
  - name: logs-oidc-config
    files:
      - secrets.yaml
```

---

## Acceptance Criteria Check

✅ **Bucket**: Versioning enabled, AES256 encryption, no public access (via `PublicAccessBlockConfiguration`)  
✅ **IRSA**: Least-privilege policy (no wildcards on prod), OIDC trust, ServiceAccount annotation  
✅ **Kustomize**: Base + overlays separate dev/prod bucket names  
✅ **Flux**: Independent `Kustomization` resources per env with dependency ordering  
✅ **Environment Isolation**: Dev and prod paths independently deployable; changes to one don't affect the other  

This implementation follows knr-ops idioms and is ready for Git push and Flux reconciliation.
